manifest.name: REASON-µ
manifest.description: Semantic reasoning micronaut — semantic-graph query, operator detection and application (ELIZA-1 16 operators), horizontal fold (semfold). Sek-phase compute. proposal_only authority.

reason.query.description: Yax/Sek-phase: execute semantic-graph query over the active knowledge graph — matches subject, predicate, object patterns; returns scored candidate triples with field provenance.

reason.fold.description: Sek-phase: apply semantic fold (hylomorphism) — unfolds input into primitive evidence graph, applies horizontal fold across evidence nodes, refolds into collapsed conclusion. Output: semfold_result with confidence.

reason.apply.description: Sek-phase: apply ELIZA-1 reasoning operators to semfold_result — detects and executes one of 16 operators (CAUSE, CONTRAST, DEPENDENCY, CONSTRAINT, EVIDENCE, SEQUENCE, BOUNDARY, STATE, CONFLICT, ALTERNATIVE, INVARIANT, TEST, RELATION, SUBSTITUTE, VERIFY, DIRECT).

reason.health.description: Pop-phase: reports semfold engine status, operator coverage, last query trace.
